generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Pre-qualification conditions are explained in tender booklet. Interested bidders shallabide by the rules and conditions mentioned in the standard tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

We hereby declare that we have carefully read, fully understood, and unconditionallyaccept and agree to all the general conditions, statutory regulations, labor welfare rules,safety requirements, and procedural instructions specified in the tender document pagenumber 6 to 9.

technicalCriterionList.description: The prospective bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of work that is, maintenance or repair of radial gates pertaining to dams of value not less than Rs, 5.68 lakhs with GST in any reputed Industry/ PSU/ Government organization in the preceding five years (i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, the bidder should submit a copy of single work order of value not less than Rs. 5.68 lakhs with GST and corresponding satisfactory performance/work done certificate issued by the competent authority(in case of state/central Government/Government undertakings from officers not below the rank of Chief Engineer)shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current FY price level )
Agency shall upload work order pertaining to the workdone certificate uploaded.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply and replacement of position indicators for seven radial gates at BP dam along with rectification floating shaft bevel gear assembly of gate no 2 and 5.

itemList.description: Dismantling of existing floating shaft at follower side of gate No 02.with all bevel gear, spur gear and Plummer blocks including all required materials, machineries, labours and consumables etc., including machining ,pressing, ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Fixing back the dismantled bevel gear assembly, floating shaft and plumber block aligning and matching bevel gear. Touch painting including all required materials, machineries, labours and consumables etc., at gate No 02. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Dismantling of drive side bevel gears along with floating shaft assembly of gate no 05 including gear base structures. including all required materials, machineries, labours and consumables etc., ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Providing temporary firm support to removed gear base and floating shaft including ISMB. Angles and channels including all required materials, machineries, labours and consumables etc., ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Removing of old foundation bolts and drilling and removing of damaged concrete portion. including all required materials, machineries, labours and consumables etc., ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

supply and fixing of Hilti M20x200mm SS anchor bolt- 6 nos bolts washer along with fixing gelly and concreting such that to withstand trust load and vibration including all required materials, machineries, labours and consumables etc.,  at gate no 05 ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Fixing back the removed bevel gear assembly, floating shaft and plumber block aligning and matching. Touch painting including all required materials, machineries, labours and consumables etc.,  at gate No 05. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Providing, fabrication, erection, alignment, calibration, fixing of limit switches and commissioning of new dial indicator system with new chain, sprockets, gearbox unit of suitable type as per site condition of radial gates at BP dam confirming to relevant I.S.specification. fabrication support frame consisting of MS Angles 65x65x6mm of suitable quantity.including dismantling of existing system.Including cost of labours, materials,  machineries, scaffolding, transportation all leads and lifts etc.complete. to fix new postion indicator at BP dam radial gates. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.
